name: aes-stream
listed_description: A fast AES-based stream cipher for C.
reason: No numbers anywhere reachable. README says only 'simple, but fast', 'designed to fill large buffers' and 'Clang 7 appears to produce faster code than gcc 8' (no figures); repo holds only src/aes-stream.c and aes-stream.h, no benchmark. It is an AES-PRF random number generator with fast key erasure (AES-NI required), not a stream cipher as the list says. Two WebSearches found no third-party throughput numbers. 21 stars, BSD-2-Clause per GitHub (list tag says ISC), last commit 2023-07-15.

name: libhydrogen
listed_description: A lightweight, secure, easy-to-use crypto library suitable for constrained environments.
reason: No speed comparison anywhere reachable. README and the 15-page wiki give design goals (Gimli plus Curve25519 only, zero heap allocation, stack median 32 bytes and max 128 bytes) and explicitly list 'replacing libsodium' as a non-goal; no benchmark directory in the repo root listing; one WebSearch for libhydrogen versus libsodium speed returned nothing. 785 stars, ISC, active.

name: micro-ecc
listed_description: A small and fast ECDH and ECDSA implementation for 8-bit, 32-bit, and 64-bit processors.
reason: Own numbers have no named baseline: static-branch README (raw.githubusercontent.com/kmackay/micro-ecc/static/README.md) lists absolute times only, e.g. secp256r1 ECDH 7.9 ms on a Raspberry Pi B+ (gcc 4.8.2 -O3) and 2220 ms with uECC_asm_fast vs 4790 ms with uECC_asm_small on a 16 MHz ATmega256RFR2 (avr-gcc 4.8.1 -Os); master README dropped the tables. No comparison against mbedTLS, TinyCrypt or OpenSSL in README, issues or repo. Lead for a retry from an environment that reaches esp32.com: forum threads (viewtopic p=91912, p=90632, p=113244) reportedly say mbedtls_ecdsa_read_signature took about 900 ms on an ESP32 at 160 MHz and micro-ecc was around 5x faster; seen only in WebSearch summaries, page EGRESS_BLOCKED, unverified. p256-m README compares only against TinyCrypt, not micro-ecc. 1.4k stars, BSD-2-Clause, last commit 2024-11-14.
